s: This article discusses adapting website structure and content for AI model training, focusing on preparing content for curated training sets and real-time retrieval, influenced by Peter Drucker's client-first philosophy and the evolution of SEO.
sub: Client-first mindset and Peter Drucker's customer-centricity in SEO.
Evolution of SEO from merit-based to resource-driven, and the impact of AI.
Strategies for structuring websites for AI model training (curated sets) and real-time queries (RAG).
Adapting existing content for AI training data formats (prompt/response).
